programmes/commissioning-health-check: One commissioning area: questionnaire, review of existing material, up to eight confidential interviews, a half-day leadership session, and a concise action report.
programmes/commissioning-simulation: A two-day facilitated simulation for up to 24 participants, including preparation, participant materials, and a structured debrief.
programmes/commissioning-ten-step-introd: Three facilitated programme days for up to 20 participants, learning materials, and guided application between sessions.
programmes/contract-management-developme: A bespoke cohort of up to 16 people: six 90-minute online development sessions, a three-hour application session, preparation, and practice materials.
programmes/leading-transformation: A bespoke online cohort of up to 20 people, covering the 24-module repertoire through 24 facilitated 90-minute sessions over twelve months, with learning materials and application between sessions. Individual coaching and an immersive simulation can be added.
programmes/place-based-academies: A cohort of up to 24 people: sponsor scoping, six development days, six facilitated action-learning sessions, and support to review up to four live challenge projects over six months.
systems-leadership-academy: A cohort of up to 20 people: four development days, three facilitated peer-learning sessions, sponsor scoping, and application to a shared partnership issue over four months.
transformation-academies: A cohort of up to 20 people: six development days, four action-learning sessions, sponsor scoping, and review of live transformation projects over six months.
lgr-academy: Up to 20 participants: four development days and four online project clinics, with sponsor scoping and work on live reorganisation questions.
devolution-academy: Up to 20 participants: four development days, three action-learning sessions, and sponsor scoping around shared responsibilities and place-based work.
accredited-training: An initial review of one existing short programme: documentation review, a design discussion, and written recommendations. This review does not itself confer accreditation; any assessment, recognition, or renewal arrangement is quoted separately.
programmes/service-transformation-progra: An indicative budgeting allowance for a multi-day partner programme. Basis confirms the current curriculum, cohort size, duration, and delivery price before any booking; this is a PSTA planning estimate, not a published Basis tariff.
